title: Tensor rank explorer — why dimensions explode memory

checkpoints.hint: Step rank 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 and watch the block count go 1 → 3 → 9 → 27: each new dimension MULTIPLIES the whole structure. Now read the right panel — at model scale (each dimension 4096) that same jump runs 2 B → 8 KiB → 32 MiB → 128 GiB, and the rank-3 tensor no longer fits in one chip's HBM. That's why adding a dimension is the scariest thing you can do to a memory budget.
